messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down stock car racing game with derby-style contact, 12 drivers, and closed-circuit dirt/mud races.

## Requirements
- 12-car race, not only a demolition derby.
- Closed circuit races.
- Both dirt and mud track options.
- 2D visual style only.
- Mobile-responsive touch controls and desktop keyboard controls.
- Three-lap racing with position, lap, timing, speed, and finish HUD.

## Decisions
- Use a canvas-rendered oval circuit with an orbiting staggered start grid.
- The player starts in position 6.
- Provide WASD/arrow controls plus Space handbrake and touch controls.
- Include AI opponents, collision damage/slowdown, skid marks, dust, and surface-specific grip.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with menu, race HUD, countdown, results overlay, track selection, and touch controls.
- Created `style.css` with responsive 2D presentation and desktop/mobile layouts.
- Built the main canvas race implementation in `game.js`.
- Added dirt and mud track variants, 12-car grid, AI, collisions, lap tracking, race timer, and results.
- Added desktop and mobile control handling.

### Active
- Final verification of JavaScript syntax, browser rendering, and gameplay behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js`.
2. Start the local server and inspect the game in a browser.
3. Test race start, keyboard/touch controls, lap completion, track switching, and results.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main page structure and UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Visual styling and responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Race engine, rendering, AI, collisions, and controls.

## Important Context
- Work is uncommitted.
- The player car is intentionally assigned index 5 to enforce a sixth-place starting position.
- Browser verification and an actual gameplay test remain outstanding.
